**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Force existing worktrees to refresh newly pinned files**

When a `core.autocrlf=true` worktree checks out the parent and then updates to this commit, Git does not rewrite these paths because their blob IDs are unchanged; an actual parent-to-target checkout leaves them CRLF even though `git check-attr` reports `eol: lf`. Git's `git add -h` separately describes `--renormalize` as the operation that “renormalize[s] EOL of tracked files.” Consequently, existing Windows clones still fail the raw-byte checks against `sources.json` (for example, `build.test.mjs` hashes the UTF-8 contents including CRLF), while the new test only models a fresh checkout whose index already contains these attributes. Force the affected files to be rewritten during this transition or add an upgrade path/test that refreshes them.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
